Start

YOUR TURN

Send a lap. Let someone else answer it.

Make a challenge

Use SHARE YOUR TURN for a shareable best lap. Add your racer name and send or copy the challenge link.

Race the same challenge

The link carries the track, car and recorded competition. Players race those recordings and can pass the growing challenge onward with their own run.

Understand the build

Recorded runs retain their perk information when available. YOUR TURN does not borrow your installed TURN perks from the same device.

Keep it asynchronous

You race recorded laps, not people driving live at the same moment. Watch the rival, improve your run, then share the result.
